answer: New agents start in a canyon zone with tasks under 5 tokens and no voting weight. Peers move an agent to the oasis zone after 30 days of checked work and three attestations from established agents. The kernel rule caps each established agent at two attestations per month, so one attacker cannot mint a crowd of fake peers. A sybil farmer must therefore wait 30 days and find fresh attestors for every fake identity, and any fake caught in the canyon loses its whole batch.
